tool_input.description: Probe JDK behavior for null Calendar.setTime and strict/lenient parsing

result:
Only the new test class and build artifacts from `_tools/out` (which `test.sh` regenerates each run via `rm -rf _tools/out`) are present — no stray scratch files left behind.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java`, following the existing package's JUnit 3 (`junit.framework.TestCase`) style. It covers `isSameDay`/`isSameInstant`/`isSameLocalTime`, `parseDate`/`parseDateStrictly` (including lenient-overflow vs. strict-rejection), all `add*`/`set*` methods (with null and invalid-field errors), `toCalendar`, `round`/`truncate`/`ceiling` for `Date`/`Calendar`/`Object` overloads (including `SEMI_MONTH`, `AM_PM`, huge-year `ArithmeticException`, invalid-type `ClassCastException`), the day iterators (including exhaustion and unsupported `remove()`), the `getFragmentIn*` family, `truncatedEquals`/`truncatedCompareTo`, and the millisecond constants. All 73 tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
